title: R5 — Internal Semantic Sweep for a Universal Polynomial Route Law

target.statement_ru: Доказать закон, который для каждого допустимого CNF polynomially находит следующий правильный маленький ключ, сохраняет exact semantics и гарантирует polynomial progress до SAT/UNSAT.
target.uniformity: One fixed deterministic theorem-mode program, fixed grammar, fixed canonical order and fixed input-relative polynomial exponents before input.
target.theorem_boundary: If all universal obligations below are proved for arbitrary CNF, SAT is in P and therefore P=NP. No such universal proof is established by this artifact.

coverage.method: TOPA+Spider style semantic-mechanics mining: recursive repository-tree inspection, orthogonal searches for trajectory/invariant/budget/rank/prune/successor/closure/P-vs-NP mechanics, direct reading of high-value P-vs-NP lawsets and reverse passes, then deliberate translation of apparently unrelated JSON mechanics into theorem-relevant formulas.
coverage.coverage_boundary: This is a broad high-recall semantic sweep, not a formal proof that every file in the repository was manually interpreted. Mechanic translations are hypotheses until independently proved in the SAT theorem domain. ASSOCIATION != PROOF.

central_discovery.existing_statement_normalized: For every arbitrary-CNF input phi and every nonterminal state S reachable under one frozen deterministic JANUS algorithm, at least one canonically selectable exact certified action exists that preserves the original-N polynomial envelope and strict progress; total discovery, execution, normalization, certificate/verifier work and macrostep count are bounded by fixed polynomials in |phi|.
central_discovery.semantic_equivalence_to_current_target: This is nearly the same theorem skeleton as POLY_FIND + POLY_HOLD + POLY_ADVANCE. It was present before the present R5 arXiv sweep; the missing part is mathematical proof of universal action availability, envelope preservation and bounded progress for arbitrary CNF.

POLY_FIND.conditional_cost: If T_Sigma<=poly(n), |Sigma|<=poly(n), T_ADMIT<=poly(n), and completeness guarantees at least one admitted q at every nonterminal reachable state, then T_NEXT<=poly(n).

POLY_HOLD.formula: B(n)=n^c for one fixed c; for every reachable K_t, all state bytes, representation nodes, contexts, bitlength, discovery, normalization, certificates, verification and outstanding charged resources remain <= fixed polynomials in original n.
POLY_HOLD.counterexample_to_local_reasoning: s_0=n; s_(t+1)=s_t^2 gives s_t=n^(2^t), although every individual update is polynomial in the current state.

POLY_ADVANCE.formula: 0<=mu(F,K)<=p(n), mu(F,K_next)<mu(F,K) for every nonterminal macrostep; additionally 0<=rho_micro<=p(n) and every normalization microstep strictly decreases rho_micro or a frozen acyclic defect level.
POLY_ADVANCE.open_substance: Construct and prove such ranks on every reachable arbitrary-CNF state without hiding exponential bitlength or micro-normalization.

combined_conditional_route_lemma.name: POLYNOMIAL_COMPLETE_NEXT_EXACT_RANK_WITH_GPEI
assumptions: n=|F| and one fixed deterministic theorem program A is frozen before F.
Sigma(F,K) is generated in polynomial time and contains at most polynomially many candidate actions for every nonterminal K in Reach_A(F).
ADMIT(F,K,a) is an exact polynomial-time predicate that checks local contextual soundness, fixed-budget compliance and progress without SAT/equivalence/future-goodness oracle.
Completeness: for every nonterminal reachable K there exists at least one a in Sigma(F,K) with ADMIT=PASS.
NEXT is the first admitted action under a fixed canonical order, so no semantic quality optimization or advice is needed.
APPLY(F,K,a) is exact and polynomial-time and preserves one original-input envelope B(n)=n^c across all charged state and lifecycle resources.
A polynomially computable integer rank mu(F,K) lies in [0,p(n)] and strictly decreases after every committed nonterminal macrostep.
Internal NORMALIZE has its own polynomially bounded well-founded micro-rank or acyclic defect dependency order.
Terminal SAT/UNSAT query is exact and polynomial-time.
derivation: GPEI prevents repeated locally-polynomial operations from growing the state outside a fixed original-n polynomial envelope.
Strict decrease of integer mu in [0,p(n)] gives at most p(n)+1 committed macrosteps.
The micro-rank separately bounds work hidden inside each normalization macrostep.
Polynomial macrostep count times polynomial per-step lifecycle cost is polynomial in n.
With exact terminal correctness for arbitrary CNF, SAT is in P; because SAT is NP-complete, P=NP.

second_route_that_removes_best_move_sear.name: SRR_ENFC_PLUS_GPEI_FIXED_SCHEDULE_ROUTE
second_route_that_removes_best_move_sear.core_idea: Do not search for the best pivot at all. Freeze a syntactic pivot schedule and move the theorem burden from route selection into schedule-relative reachable closure.
second_route_that_removes_best_move_sear.required_theorem: For every CNF and every S_t reachable under this one schedule, the exact elimination+normalization step terminates in polynomial work, preserves a polynomial-size tractable representation under GPEI, and after polynomially many scheduled eliminations reaches a polynomial-time terminal truth query.
second_route_that_removes_best_move_sear.why_important: Here POLY_FIND becomes trivial/canonical; the difficult universal obligation becomes SRR_ENFC + GPEI + micro-normalization rank. This is structurally cleaner than assuming a polynomially discoverable globally good pivot.

direct_internal_law_ancestors.observed_mechanic: Only exact certified useful actions may commit; canonical deterministic selection; global original-N envelope; discovery is charged; strict progress and micro-normalization required.
direct_internal_law_ancestors.formula_translation: forall K in Reach_A(F), exists canonically selectable a: Exact(a,K) AND GPEI(K,a) AND Progress(K,a), with total discovery+apply+normalize+verify <= poly(n).

direct_internal_law_ancestors.observed_mechanic: Finite machine halts before the first unproved repeated Stage4 transition; exact Hall lane is admitted when structurally recognized; first universal halt is iterated GPEI preservation.
direct_internal_law_ancestors.formula_translation: Exact family lanes may discharge recognized states in polytime, but a universal theorem needs forall reachable K: Stage4(K) exists AND stays in B(n) AND costs poly(n).

direct_internal_law_ancestors.observed_mechanic: Exact polynomial structural recognizer switches a generic exponential-capable resolution route into matching/Hall polynomial decision and certificate.
direct_internal_law_ancestors.formula_translation: Recognize_C(F)=1 => Route_C(F) in P; ambiguity => OPEN. Exact recognition cost is part of the route.
direct_internal_law_ancestors.missing_obligation: A finite portfolio of special lanes is useful only if their union plus a generic lane covers every arbitrary CNF with a common polynomial envelope.

direct_internal_law_ancestors.observed_mechanic: For m<=4, DP clause count is invariant; every admitted root-free v3 atomic plan decreases live-variable count by at least one; one discovery pass is polynomial under the envelope.
direct_internal_law_ancestors.missing_obligation: Unbounded arbitrary-CNF totality; the m<=7 generalization was independently refuted.

direct_internal_law_ancestors.observed_mechanic: Exact latent algebraic structures can replace explicit combinatorial expansion only with replayable semantics and resource accounting.
direct_internal_law_ancestors.formula_translation: Compression/quotient is theorem-relevant only if POLY_DISCOVERY AND EXACT_SEMANTICS AND POLY_CERT_BYTES AND POLY_VERIFY AND POLY_STATE AND STRICT_GLOBAL_PROGRESS AND POLY_STEP_COUNT AND ARBITRARY_CNF_COVERAGE.

semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.observed_mechanic: Move an exact quotient certificate before child materialization instead of compressing an exponential tree after birth; on the equality family 2^256 represented prefixes become 257 symbolic states with O(n^2) family-specific construction/verification proxy.
semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.formula_translation: If ParentCertifiesOrbit(K) in poly(n), quotient actions before materialization: Children(K)/~ -> Representatives(K).
semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.missing_obligation: Universal polynomial generator discovery, orbit coverage and quotient-state bound.

semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.observed_mechanic: A failed exact-context-local candidate can be tombstoned so the identical failed replay is not paid twice, while the cache cannot authorize a positive transition or propagate to descendants.
semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.formula_translation: Fail(K,a)=verified => cache[(K,a)]=DEAD; future identical query cost O(lookup), but cache cannot imply Safe(K,a').
semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.missing_obligation: LOCAL_DEDUP != POLY_TOTAL_DISCOVERY; number of distinct failed candidates may still be superpolynomial.

semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.observed_mechanic: Exact typed fragmentation and dedup reduced aggregate stored payload while preserving exact parent recovery and forward replay.
semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.formula_translation: Store(unique fragments)+poly manifests may be smaller than monolithic deltas while Replay(manifest)=exact state.
semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.missing_obligation: Finite dedup ratio does not establish a polynomial representation bound for arbitrary CNF trajectories.

semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.observed_mechanic: JANUS = SEARCH_GRAMMAR + REPRESENTATION_GRAMMAR + INTERFACE_GRAMMAR; cheap verification does not make discovery free; exact future projections and boundary certificates are required.
semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.formula_translation: C_route=C_search+C_repr+C_interface+C_transition+C_verify+C_update+debt; no component may be omitted from the polynomial theorem.
semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.missing_obligation: A fixed global exponent for arbitrary SAT is not established.

semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.observed_mechanic: Spider/fingerprints/M2R/Pippi may rank or propose representation routes, but delayed learning cannot prune exact scope without a proof certificate.
semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.formula_translation: HeuristicRank(a) may reorder Sigma, but ADMIT/Exact authority remains independent; heuristic score cannot remove a potentially required action unless SafePrune is proved.
semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.missing_obligation: No heuristic ranking theorem supplies universal candidate-grammar completeness.

semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.observed_mechanic: Recursive discovery explicitly carries depth/result/scan budgets, immutable source pins and zero authority for observations.
semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.formula_translation: SearchSurface(n) must expose explicit depth/result/scan budgets; discovery output is a candidate observation, not transition authority.
semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.missing_obligation: An engineering bounded scan does not prove that a complete SAT action surface fits a polynomial budget.

semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.observed_mechanic: Adaptive choices remain valid only under a history-wise conditional cap; marginal fairness is insufficient and has an explicit counterexample.
semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.formula_translation: For an adaptive theorem route, a per-step invariant must hold conditional on the complete admissible history H_t, not merely on average over trajectories: Bound(step_t | H_t)<=p(n).
semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.missing_obligation: Anytime statistical validity is not a polynomial-runtime theorem; only the history-wise proof pattern transfers.

semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.observed_mechanic: Candidate operators are staged before expansion, must preserve Boolean answer and exact reversible certificates, and are not promoted when charged cost worsens.
semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.formula_translation: Admit(o,K)=ExactPreserve AND Replayable AND BudgetOK; else state unchanged. Early certified filters should act before expansion when possible.
semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.missing_obligation: Historical inspiration is not algorithmic evidence and finite cost gates are not universal asymptotics.

semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.formula_translation: A theorem-safe analogue would require SafePrune(K,a) to prove no necessary exact route is removed, and Grow only when the global envelope permits it.
semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.missing_obligation: Learned usefulness is heuristic and cannot establish exact completeness.

semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.observed_mechanic: RESOURCE_CONTRACTION proposes R_(t+1)<R_t while quality Q does not regress; PHYSARUM_CONTRACTOR proposes pruning expensive branches while preserving robust paths.
semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.formula_translation: Candidate theorem rank pattern: R_(t+1)<R_t AND ExactCoverage(K_(t+1))=ExactCoverage(K_t), with R integer/poly-bounded and both conditions poly-checkable.
semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.missing_obligation: Q must be replaced by an exact correctness/coverage invariant; heuristic quality cannot serve as theorem authority.

semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.observed_mechanic: Fixed outer phase sequence from seed through discovery/falsification/reverse projection to frozen result.
semantic_translations_from_apparently_un.formula_translation: Number of outer phases is O(1), but theorem complexity is sum of inner phase work.

negative_laws_preserved.meaning: Do not extrapolate the m<=4/m<=6 local invariant to arbitrary clause counts.
24 exact finite cases with zero mismatches localize barriers but do not close correctness, trajectory, representation, discovery, update, verifier or debt bounds.
Exact bidirectional recovery can coexist with exponential enumeration or high discovery/canonicalization cost.

ROUTE_A_COMPLETE_CANDIDATE_GRAMMAR.formula: Sigma_poly_complete + CanonicalFirstAdmitted + ExactApply + GPEI + polynomial macro-rank + polynomial micro-rank => polynomial exact route.
ROUTE_A_COMPLETE_CANDIDATE_GRAMMAR.primary_risk: Completeness or admission may encode the original SAT decision problem.

ROUTE_B_FIXED_SCHEDULE_CLOSURE.formula: FixedSyntacticPivot + SRR_ENFC + GPEI + polynomial normalization micro-rank => polynomial exact route.
ROUTE_B_FIXED_SCHEDULE_CLOSURE.primary_risk: A fixed schedule may force representation/context blow-up; universal schedule-relative closure is the hard theorem.

two_candidate_theorem_routes.relation: Route B removes semantic best-move discovery but demands stronger universal closure; Route A allows representation/action choice but must prove complete polynomial discovery without hidden oracle/advice.

candidate_safe_accelerators_not_theorem_.prebirth_quotient: Discover and certify exact branch orbit/decomposition before child materialization.
candidate_safe_accelerators_not_theorem_.local_negative_tombstone: Never replay the identical verified failure in the identical exact context.
candidate_safe_accelerators_not_theorem_.typed_fragment_dedup: Share exact typed recovery payloads with replayable manifests.
candidate_safe_accelerators_not_theorem_.exact_family_lanes: Recognize tractable structure polynomially and dispatch to an exact polynomial solver/certificate.
candidate_safe_accelerators_not_theorem_.heuristic_ordering: TOPA/Spider/M2R/Keymaster may rank candidates but cannot prune theorem scope without exact proof.

r5_attack_plan.target: Freeze Sigma(F,K) and prove generation size/time polynomial plus completeness on every nonterminal reachable arbitrary-CNF state.
r5_attack_plan.killer_test: Find a reachable family where every candidate in the frozen surface fails or where producing the surface requires superpolynomial work.

r5_attack_plan.target: Construct polynomial-bit mu and rho_micro with polynomial range and strict decrease under every admitted action/normalization rewrite.
r5_attack_plan.killer_test: Exponential range, precision, cyclic rewrite, or exponentially many unit decreases.

r5_attack_plan.target: Prove one B(n)=n^c envelope for state, context, interface, bitlength, discovery, cert, verification, update, switching and debt across all reachable states.
r5_attack_plan.killer_test: Iterated locally-polynomial growth escapes every frozen input-relative exponent.

r5_attack_plan.target: Run the same hostile CNF families through Route A and Route B to identify whether the first unavoidable barrier is discovery completeness or schedule-relative closure.
r5_attack_plan.killer_test: Route A needs semantic lookahead while Route B suffers unavoidable representation/context blow-up.

r5_attack_plan.target: Measure exact generator/decomposition discovery coverage before child birth on adversarial non-symmetric/non-factorized formulas with all failed discovery charged.
r5_attack_plan.killer_test: Polynomial symmetry/quotient finder exists but quotient still has exponentially many states, or useful exact structure is too sparse.

strongest_current_answer.formula: COMPLETE_POLY_CANDIDATE_GRAMMAR + CANONICAL_FIRST_ADMITTED + GPEI + POLY_WELL_FOUNDED_RANK + POLY_MICRO_RANK + EXACT_TERMINAL_QUERY => POLYNOMIAL_EXACT_ROUTE
strongest_current_answer.alternate_formula: FIXED_SYNTACTIC_SCHEDULE + SRR_ENFC + GPEI + POLY_MICRO_RANK + EXACT_TERMINAL_QUERY => POLYNOMIAL_EXACT_ROUTE
strongest_current_answer.why_this_matters: The meta-registry already contained all three logical pieces POLY_FIND, POLY_HOLD and POLY_ADVANCE as separate theorem fragments. The present sweep reconciles them into one explicit candidate theorem skeleton and separates direct SAT obligations from cross-domain analogies.
strongest_current_answer.not_yet_answered: No artifact proves candidate-grammar completeness, universal SRR_ENFC/GPEI preservation, or a polynomially bounded progress rank for every arbitrary CNF.

provenance.semantic_translation_policy: Unrelated-domain mechanics are labeled ANALOGY_ONLY unless the source itself contains a theorem directly applicable to the SAT route. No metaphor or association is promoted into mathematical proof.
